On #TheAmanpourHour this week:
• @ChrisMurphyCT slams the managing of the Iran war as "incompetent".
• Cardinal Czerny & theologian Anna Rowlands on the Pope's new efforts to "disarm" AI.
• Law professor Kimberlé Crenshaw discusses the erosion of US civil rights.

Video

In This Is Also a Love Story, journalist @sallyhayd tells tales of love surviving in the darkest of circumstances. She says she wrote it partly for herself: “I was feeling despair at the cruelty of humans… I needed to remind myself that there’s kindness & goodness in the world.”

Video

Kimberlé Crenshaw pioneered ideas of intersectionality & critical race theory. Now we see the backlash, does she wish she’d done anything differently? “Not at all… Whatever we call these things, if they’re about… creating equality… there’s always going to be resistance.”

Video

“There are efforts to break our democracy, to unravel basic protections, to render certain voters unable to elect people of our choice,” argues Kimberlé Crenshaw. “These are all the fundamental aspects of a nation that is moving into tyranny.”

Video

“We are fighting for the soul of a multiracial democracy,” activist and academic Kimberlé Crenshaw tells me, warning that if efforts to roll back civil rights “are successful, it will be a long time before we’ll see the opportunity to regain everything that we’ve lost.”

Video

“Russia managed to hack the Democrats’ inboxes”  With fears growing of Russian election interference in the 2026 midterms, Christiane & Jamie reflect on the controversy over the 2016 Presidential election and whether Russia influenced its outcome.

Video

Congrats @clarissaward! An important and revelatory investigation


CNN Communications (@CNNPR)

Chasing a Ghost: The Search for Austin Tice (@ClarissaWard) won the Emmy® for Outstanding Hard News Report: Long Form.





— https://nitter.net/CNNPR/status/2060083538129453507#m

“We have become too risk averse. And we have to change that.” @RGrynspan is contending to be the next Secretary-General of the United Nations. She says that, as the daughter of World War Two refugees, “I know exactly what war takes away from you and what peace allows you.”

Video

“Trump’s ratings are tanking”

As tensions rise after US strikes on Iran in “self-defence”, @amanpour reflects on why Trump is desperate to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and negotiate a peace deal 

Watch Christiane Amanpour Presents: The Ex Files 🗂️ on @globalplayer 🎧

Video

“Even the most sacred things in our life, like our kids’ youth sports, [are] being purchased and then sold back to us.” Senator @ChrisMurphyCT tells me about how even at his son’s hockey game, he saw what he describes as a “Crisis of the Common Good”, the subject of his new book.

Video

“America is humiliated… and Iran is getting stronger… This war has been perhaps the most incompetent run war in the modern history of the United States,” says Democratic Senator @ChrisMurphyCT. “We are going to get a worse deal” after this war, he argues.

Video

Huge congratulations Jeremy, Zeena, Ibrahim and the whole team! So well deserved, a brilliant interview through and through.


Jeremy Diamond (@JDiamond1)

So honored to have won an Emmy for my interview with senior Hamas official Ghazi Hamad. This was one of the most challenging interviews I’ve ever prepared for, but I had a clear idea of how I wanted to approach it from the outset (more on that in the video) and a phenomenal team that helped execute it.
Was thrilled to celebrate with producer

“We've lost that ability to talk to and listen to one another.” In his new book “All We Say,” former Obama speechwriter @brhodes traces complex threads of American history through fifteen iconic speeches, from Franklin to Reagan to Trump.

Video

“Peace has to come, and will only come, when people are regarded with equality, when the core causes of these conflicts are addressed,” says longtime peace negotiator Oliver McTernan, who has just returned from the Middle East. “You can’t have peace without justice.”

Video

“We are in a circumstance where, because [Iran has] demonstrated that they can shut down the Strait of Hormuz and paralyze the global economy, they now have a deterrent without having a nuclear weapon,” says fmr. national security official @brhodes

Video

The Trump administration is likely headed for a deal with Iran that closely resembles the JCPOA, says former Obama adviser @brhodes. But, he adds, “Trump's incapacity to kind of stay quiet through this diplomacy, I think, is part of the reason that we're not at a deal yet.”

Video

Pope Leo has issued a stark warning about AI in his first encyclical. Cardinal Czerny tells me "Pope Leo the 13th issued his call for the protection of human dignity without real dialog with those who were imperiling that dignity. This time Pope Leo (the 14th) is issuing the warnings in dialog with those who are responsible for AI... this is an extraordinary step forward."

Video

"The Cuban people are tired... they're tired of feeling like they're just barely surviving." With the Trump administration continuing to pressure Cuba, Cuban-American historian Ada Ferrer tells me "you have a mounting humanitarian crisis piling on top of a situation that was already almost untenable even before January... the situation is dire."

Video
